bullets.id: NFP September hanya bertambah 29 ribu (konsensus sekitar 90 ribu), pengangguran naik ke 4,2% dan upah per jam cuma naik 0,1%. Emas sempat melonjak ke sekitar $4.223, tapi lonjakan itu habis: emas spot ditutup turun sekitar 0,9% di $4.140–4.142 pada Jumat.
bullets.en: September payrolls added just 29K jobs (consensus near 90K), unemployment rose to 4.2% and hourly pay rose only 0.1%. Gold briefly spiked to about $4,223, but the jump faded: spot gold closed Friday down about 0.9% at $4,140–4,142.

bullets.id: Peluang kenaikan suku bunga Fed Oktober turun ke sekitar 22% dari sekitar 70% awal pekan, tapi risiko kenaikan Desember masih ada. Yield 10 tahun kembali ke kisaran 5,25% setelah yield 10 dan 30 tahun mencapai level tertinggi sejak 2002, dan Brent di $101. Emas turun 7,5% sebulan dan mencatat pelemahan mingguan kedua.
bullets.en: Odds of an October Fed hike fell to about 22% from roughly 70% early in the week, but December hike risk remains. The 10-year yield is back near 5.25% after 10- and 30-year yields hit their highest since 2002, and Brent is at $101. Gold is down 7.5% over the month and posted a second weekly loss.

bullets.id: Level kunci dari Kitco: resistance $4.204–4.231, support $4.150 lalu $4.111, dengan $4.100 sebagai garis pertahanan utama dan low Juni di $4.009. Emas kini sekitar 26% di bawah rekor Januari $5.608. Data berikutnya: ISM Jasa hari Senin dan CPI AS pada 14 Oktober.
bullets.en: Key levels from Kitco: resistance at $4,204–4,231, support at $4,150 then $4,111, with $4,100 the main line of defense and the June low at $4,009. Gold now sits about 26% below its January record of $5,608. Next data: ISM Services on Monday and US CPI on October 14.

bullets.id: Antam turun Rp2.000 ke Rp2.574.000/gram, buyback turun Rp6.000 ke Rp2.380.000, sehingga spread melebar ke Rp194.000 (7,5%). Galeri24 Rp2.511.000 (buyback Rp2.370.000) dan UBS Rp2.535.000 (buyback Rp2.344.000). Bantal struktural: bank sentral beli 289 ton di Q2 dan ETF emas bertambah 50 ton sepanjang September.
bullets.en: Antam fell Rp2,000 to Rp2,574,000/gram and buyback fell Rp6,000 to Rp2,380,000, widening the spread to Rp194,000 (7.5%). Galeri24 is at Rp2,511,000 (buyback Rp2,370,000) and UBS at Rp2,535,000 (buyback Rp2,344,000). Structural cushion: central banks bought 289t in Q2 and gold ETFs added 50t through September.
